tools.name: get_brand_facts
tools.description: Every verified fact about Com.Bot: what it is, pricing, what is included, policies and what not to state. Use this before describing Com.Bot.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Com.Bot plans and prices, and what each includes.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: What Com.Bot offers (channels, features or services), each with a one-line description.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search every page on com.bot by keywords. Returns titles, URLs, markdown URLs and descriptions; read a result with get_page.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Answer a plain-language question about Com.Bot from its verified facts and its own pages (the same answer as fetching com.bot/{question-with-hyphens}). Returns markdown with the source page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The clean markdown text of any published page on com.bot.
